/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0010_GET_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
 * Description  : NOTICE MESSAGE 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/02/22   ygkim   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0010_GET_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER]
  @p_notice_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
		SELECT
              m.notice_id
              ,r.notice_title as notice_main_title
              ,m.language_code
			  ,ld.segment2 language
              ,m.notice_title
              ,m.notice_content
			  ,m.notice_image
			  ,m.notice_image_id
        FROM
              SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER m WITH(NOLOCK)
			  INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER r WITH(NOLOCK) on r.notice_id = m.notice_id
			  INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER lm WITH(NOLOCK) ON lm.lookup_type = 'LANGUAGE' AND lm.valid_yn = 'Y'
			  INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL ld WITH(NOLOCK) ON ld.lookup_type = lm.lookup_type and ld.segment1 = m.language_code and  ld.valid_yn = 'Y'
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND   m.notice_id   = @p_notice_id
   ;
END

/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0010_GET_NOTICE_MASTER
 * Description  : NOTICE SET MASTER 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/02/22   ygkim   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0010_GET_NOTICE_MASTER]
  @p_module			NVARCHAR(MAX),
  @p_submodule		NVARCHAR(MAX),    
  @p_active			NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
		SELECT
               m.notice_id
              ,m.module_code
              ,m.sub_module_code
              ,m.notice_title notice_main_title
              ,m.cycle_class_code
              ,m.detail_class_code
              ,m.send_time_text
              ,m.valid_yn active_flag
        FROM
              SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER m with(nolock)
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND (@p_module IS NULL OR m.Module_Code IN 
				(SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
                FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_module, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
                CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
	           )   
		)
		AND (@p_submodule IS NULL OR m.sub_module_code IN 
				(SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
                FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_submodule, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
                CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
	           )   
		)
		AND (@p_active IS NULL OR m.valid_yn IN 
				(SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
                FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_active, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
                CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
	           )   
		)
        ORDER BY m.module_code
              ,m.sub_module_code
			  ,m.NOTICE_ID
              ,m.cycle_class_code
              ,m.detail_class_code
              ,m.send_time_text
              ,m.valid_yn
   ;
END

RGE INTO [SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER] A
						USING (
								SELECT 
									 @v_notice_id as notice_id	
									,@v_language as language					
							  ) B
						ON(
									A.notice_id = B.notice_id
								AND A.language_code = B.language				
						  )
						WHEN MATCHED THEN
							 UPDATE SET 
									notice_title		= @v_title
								   ,notice_content	= @v_content
								   ,last_updated_by		= @v_last_updated_by
								   ,last_update_date	= sysdatetime()
					                
						WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN

							INSERT	(									   
									 notice_id,language_code,notice_title,notice_content
									,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date
									)
							VALUES  
									(
									 @v_notice_id , @v_language, @v_title,@v_content
									,@v_created_by,SYSDATETIME(),@v_last_updated_by,SYSDATETIME()
									);
			
					END
				ELSE IF @v_active_flag = 'D'
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
						WHERE notice_id = @v_notice_id
						  AND language_code = @v_language;
					END
			END

			SET @v_log_type = 'END';
			SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
			SET @v_description = '';
			SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
			EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
			
			-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
			SELECT  'S' AS result_code,  @max_loop_cnt AS result_cnt ;
		END TRY

		BEGIN CATCH
		  BEGIN
			INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (program_name
										  ,log_type
										  ,log_count
										  ,log_message
										  ,description
										  ,event_date
										  ,creation_date
										  ,created_by
										  ,last_update_date
										  ,last_updated_by)
			VALUES (ERROR_PROCEDURE()
				   ,'ERROR'
				   ,NULL
				   ,ERROR_MESSAGE()
				   ,NULL
				   ,SYSDATETIME()
				   ,SYSDATETIME()
				   ,ERROR_PROCEDURE()
				   ,SYSDATETIME()
				   ,ERROR_PROCEDURE());

			IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			  COMMIT WORK;
		  END;

		  -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
		  SELECT 'F' AS result_code;
		  SELECT '[' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
		END CATCH;
	END

									   ,last_update_date	= sysdatetime()

								INSERT	(									   
										 notice_id,sub_module_code,module_code
										,notice_title,cycle_class_code,detail_class_code,send_time_text,valid_yn
										,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date

								VALUES  
										(
										 @n_history_seq , @v_submodule, @v_module

						END

				ELSE IF @v_active_flag = 'D'

						  AND notice_id = @n_history_seq;
